description: Land Title Settlement Department - Puttalam, Puttalam D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410111
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels in Puttalam district, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
